metric_semantics.activity.mean_gaps: mean(last_active - first_active + 1 - active_count | nonempty); counts layers, not runs
metric_semantics.activity.gap_fraction: fraction with at least one inactive layer inside first-to-last span, conditional on nonempty
metric_semantics.topology.connected_components_mean: all-event mean; zero for empty supports
metric_semantics.topology.largest_component_fraction_mean: all-event mean; zero for empty supports
